newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Continental to offer new Brazil flights.
newsitem.headline: Continental to offer new Brazil flights.

text.p: U.S. carrier Continental Airlines Inc said it will offer new daily flights to Newark International Airport near New York City from Brazil beginning July 11.
"The new flights will open the doors to South America's largest business center and tourism market," Barry Simon, Continental's international vice-president, said in a statement.
The new route marks the company's entrance into the Brazilian market and will increase to 29 the number of cities Continental flies to in Latin America and the Caribbean, it said.
Continental flights to Brazil will use DC-10 planes. The airline is the United States' fifth largest carrier with revenues of $6.3 billion in 1996.
